intent: Technical Brief: ASUS ZenBook Pro Duo System State Baseline
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling, BSOD due to hardware failure
suggested_solution: Run a stress test on the system to identify any thermal throttling issues.
Check for BIOS updates and install the latest version.
Update drivers to the latest versions.
Run a disk cleanup and defragmentation to optimize storage performance.
Monitor system temperatures and adjust cooling settings as needed.
